description: EventFlow backend redeploy on EC2 (ADR-DEVOPS-008): pull image from ECR, run Prisma migrate deploy against RDS from the instance, and restart the backend container. Secrets are read from SSM Parameter Store on the instance and never echoed (SEC-02/SEC-03). Consumed by .github/workflows/deploy-backend.yml.

imageRef.description: Full ECR image reference to deploy (registry/repo:tag).

envName.description: SSM environment whose secrets are injected.

region.description: AWS region for ECR login and SSM parameter reads.

prismaVersion.description: Prisma CLI version used to apply migrations (pinned to backend/package.json).

runCommand: aws ecr get-login-password --region "$REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$REGISTRY" >/dev/null
echo '[cd-redeploy] applying prisma migrations (migrate deploy — idempotent, applies only committed pending migrations)'
docker run --rm --network eventflow -e DATABASE_URL="$DB" -w /app --entrypoint sh "$IMAGE" -c "npx --yes prisma@$PV migrate deploy"

docker run -d --name backend --restart always --network eventflow -e NODE_ENV=development -e PORT=3000 -e DATABASE_URL="$DB" -e JWT_SECRET="$JWT" -e SESSION_SECRET="$SES" -e CORS_ORIGINS='https://main.d2jh1ql4whmeue.amplifyapp.com,https://staging.d2jh1ql4whmeue.amplifyapp.com' -e CORS_CREDENTIALS=true -e SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE=none -e SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=true -e LLM_PROVIDER=mock -e CAPTCHA_PROVIDER=mock "$IMAGE" >/dev/null
